messages:
Elena: publish blocked: regendiff on sample-onboarding tripped semver (minor) because changelog-generator treated reordered OpenAPI pieces as feature content. not a real API change.
Marco: ouch. paste the diff?
Elena: snippet:
```
- paths/sessions.yaml
- paths/oauth.yaml
+ paths/oauth.yaml
+ paths/sessions.yaml
```
Elena: changelog picked it up as a new "Added paths/sessions" line and bumped minor.
Kait: also saw a flaky sample test that toggles global retry.defaults and doesn't reset on exception; that toggle changes a generated default in typegen output on rerun -> second source of noise.
regen-bot: regendiff job #12047: 2 files ordering-only, 1 file content drift (tests/onboard-retry-leak.js). deterministic: false
Marco: two fixes: quick CI mitigation to unblock publish, and follow-ups to prevent recurrence. quick mitigation options: 1) change CI regen to run `--normalize-order` which canonicalizes and sorts maps before comparing, 2) change release-gate to ignore ordering-only diffs, 3) make changelog-generator collapse reorder hunks into no-op.
Kait: I can patch the test to avoid global mutation. will open PR to sandbox retry config and add an afterEach guard.
Elena: for the hotfix I'd prefer 1+2: add `--normalize-order` to regen job and relax gate so we don't bump semver for reorder-only. Marco can you push that?
Marco: pushing a tiny CI patch now. also adding an interim changelog filter: if a diff hunk only reorders top-level entries and hashes unchanged -> drop from changelog. cheap and safe.
ci-bot: TASK sample-onboard/regendiff RE-RUN -> Error: regendiff mismatch: ordering-only detected (treated as content)
Marco: updated regen command in CI to `yarn regen:onboard --normalize-order` and updated release-gate rule to treat ordering-only as no-semver. pushing branch devex/regen-normalize.
ci-bot: build #12048: regen run -> PASSED (no regendiff)
Elena: thanks. Kait: please include the test teardown fix + a unit asserting typegen serializer produces identical output across 10 runs in your PR.
Kait: PR #5789 opened: fixes tests/onboard-retry-leak.js, adds serializer stability unit + small changelog note.
Marco: merged CI hotfix and gate change. created follow-up tickets: DEX-984 (upstream parser: deterministic traversal), DEX-985 (changelog-generator: canonicalize before diff).
Elena: docs: adding onboarding tip: "If first-run regen shows diffs, re-run with `yarn regen:onboard --normalize-order`. Open a regendiff issue if it persists."
regen-bot: PR scan: changelog entry present; semver impact: none.
ci-bot: build #12050: all sample-onboard jobs PASSED
Elena: leaving this open until PR lands. thanks all :raised_hands:
Kait: merged PR #5789. added unit to catch future leaks.
Marco: closing after one more full run.
ci-bot: build #12052: full pipeline PASSED
Elena: closing thread 3: great fix, will follow up on upstream tickets.
